name: NASA IMS Bearing Dataset
description: The IMS Bearing dataset was generated by the NSF Center for Intelligent Maintenance Systems (IMS) and distributed via NASA. Four double-row bearings were installed on a test shaft rotating at 2,000 RPM under 6,000 lbs radial load until failure. High-frequency vibration data (20kHz sampling) were collected across three run-to-failure endurance tests for predictive maintenance benchmarking.
